scheme_name: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Rural Entrepreneurs to set up Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) of Farm Machinery
other_conditions: Individual farmers must be registered under the Krishak Bandhu (New) Scheme or belong to approved groups such as SKUS, PACS, FPO, FPC, FIG, SHG, etc.
Project cost/Total Financial Outlay must be at least ₹20,00,000 and not exceed the maximum specified in SMAM guidelines and SPMT recommendation
Applicant must have sufficient land (own, leased or hired) classified as commercial, bastu, or viti for setting up the CHC
Beneficiary or spouse cannot apply for a new CHC within four years of the last subsidy release for this scheme
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 40% of the project cost, capped at ₹16 lakhs, to help set up custom hiring centres for farm machinery.
documents_required: Printout of application with acknowledgement receipt
